description: This file defines the OrganizationsDelegationCredentialService class, which manages delegation credentials, including creation, updating, enabling/disabling, and ensuring default calendars for delegated users. It interacts with repositories, taskers, queues, and external services.

classes.name: OrganizationsDelegationCredentialService
classes.description: Service class for managing organization delegation credentials, including creation, updates, enabling/disabling, and calendar management for delegated users.

methods.name: createDelegationCredential
methods.description: Creates a new delegation credential for an organization.

methods.name: updateDelegationCredential
methods.description: Updates an existing delegation credential, including service account key and enabled status, and ensures default calendars if enabled.

methods.name: ensureDefaultCalendars
methods.description: Ensures default calendars are set for all delegated users in an organization.

methods.name: ensureDefaultCalendarsForUser
methods.description: Ensures default calendars are set for a specific user based on email domain.

methods.name: updateDelegationCredentialEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables a delegation credential.

methods.name: updateDelegationCredentialServiceAccountKey
methods.description: Encrypts and updates the service account key for a delegation credential.
